answer: Cross-Epoch Behavioural Fingerprint Rule. Each identity’s action sequence per epoch is hashed into a behavioural fingerprint, compared against its prior epochs like an ocean current checked for drift. Persistent deviation beyond a threshold, such as a jade marker of inconsistency, freezes rewards pending review. Attackers must maintain coherent long-horizon behaviour across many identities, and each abandoned fable of continuity costs a full re-simulation cycle plus forfeited accrued rewards.
